release_after_frames.instructions: Does the diff release the texture's CPU image only after every AnimationFrame using that texture has built its hit-test data (i.e. not inside Texture::init before frames exist)?

criteria.true: Release happens after frames/hit masks are built.
criteria.false: Release can happen before frames are built, or this is not established.

safe_fallback.instructions: If AnimationFrame::updateHittestdata runs on a texture whose image was released, does the new code avoid reading a null QImage (fallback instead of crash)?

criteria.false: A null image could be read.

size_cached.instructions: Do Texture::getWidth/getHeight keep returning the correct size after the image is released (size cached before release)?

ram_drop.instructions: Compare peak_rss_mb in the 1A-03 RAM receipt with the 1A-01-ram entry in state.ram_history_all_cards. Is the drop at least 300 MB?
